result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a curb ramp, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the environment is compromised by parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines and a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signaling.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway approaching the crosswalk

hazards.name: Degraded Curb Ramp Area
hazards.description: Accumulated debris and uneven pavement at the base of the curb ramp create a tripping hazard and hinder accessibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom of the curb ramp on the right side of the image

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and basic sidewalk infrastructure, but lacks physical traffic calming or a median refuge. The wide roadway and fair pavement condition near the curb suggest an environment that prioritizes vehicle flow over pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire roadway width without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt near the curb ramp could cause tripping or difficulty for mobility aid users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the road to provide a safe waiting area and allow two-stage crossing.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with a marked continental crosswalk and curb ramps, adjacent to a large green space. However, the lack of a median refuge and the long crossing distance increase pedestrian exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the left side of the image may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway, approaching the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks, a sidewalk, and a bus stop with a shelter. However, the presence of a large transit vehicle creates a significant visual obstruction, and the lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals increases the risk for those crossing the roadway.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The large SEPTA bus significantly blocks sightlines between pedestrians and motorists at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, occupying the main travel lane.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide safe crossing intervals at this signalized intersection.
